The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight compression artifacts. I believe the Router underestimated the severity of the hind foot fusion; in AI generations, fused toes are a common structural failure that warrants a higher severity (3.0) as it breaks biological plausibility. The 'plant stem' artifact is minor but valid.

The presence of prominent parotoid glands suggests it may be a different toad species (e.g., Bufo).
